items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: like, Stanford Lucia, don't you? Part of it, part of it is on the road of Jerusalem.

ctx.x: I remember on the blues, that blues for Jimmy, you'd play something that comes from,

like, Stanford Lucia, don't you? Part of it, part of it is on the road of Jerusalem. Oh yeah. That sounds like Jerusalem, part of Jerusalem. Oh yeah. The Holy City they'd call it. Oh yeah. The Holy City. You used to play that on the violin. Yeah. Oh yeah. The Holy City. You used to play that on the violin. Yeah. And those things you always bow on those.
I bow, yeah, I bow. I play a lot of stuff where I bow.
